mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate directly reduces the risk-free rate, lowering equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific trigger conditions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate exceeding 7.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 7.5% over a 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand weakness, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline over a 3-year rolling window, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals manufacturing slowdown, reducing corporate capital expenditure and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion regime, SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of INDPRO decline instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 for INDPRO in this regime.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) directly reflect robust consumer spending on durable goods, boosting corporate revenues and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without trigger conditions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC between HOUST and 20-day SPX returns < 0.03 over any 3-year window, or returns positive in <40% of HOUST >850 instances.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 0.1% indicates restrictive monetary policy, increasing borrowing costs and dampening economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in >60% of FEDFUNDS >0.1% instances over 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Weak employment growth (PAYEMS < 100k) combined with high unemployment (UNRATE > 7.5%) signals labor market stress, reducing consumer spending and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of PAYEMS <100k and UNRATE >7.5% instances over 3-year window, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In post-shock recovery, CPIAUCSL above 230 indicates persistent inflation, delaying Federal Reserve policy easing and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In post-shock recovery regime, SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of CPIAUCSL >230 instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 for CPIAUCSL in this regime.
